project_info.theme: Four high-key snack and cream flavor posters
project_info.color_palette: Clean white, herb green, banana yellow, taro lavender, cheese gold

main_subject.detail: A 2 by 2 grid of airborne snack pieces interacting with frozen glossy cream: herb chips, banana chips, taro chips and cheese crackers.
main_subject.style: High-key macro still-life food photography with playful 3D typography

composition_elements.text: HERB CRUNCH; BANANA BLISS; TARO POP; CHEESE HIT
items: Upper left: golden herb chips arc through thick white Mediterranean herb cream with oregano and thyme.
Upper right: banana chips burst through vanilla cream and sugar dust.
Lower left: lavender taro chips erupt through pastel-purple taro cream.
Lower right: cheese crackers hover over thick pale-yellow cheese dip and cheddar powder.
Every panel: floating 3D flavor title and small descriptor line on clean white background.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Ethereal white field, frozen droplets and crumbs, shallow bokeh, glossy cream highlights

technical_specs.render_style: Canon EOS R5 macro food commercial photography, 85mm f/1.2 look

assets.name: snack product and flavor references
assets.usage: Preserve actual snack shape, seasoning, color and flavor identity.

assets.name: flavor title and descriptor typography
assets.usage: Keep title wording, 3D material and panel placement accurate.

assets.name: cream, spices and crumbs
assets.usage: Use physically plausible flavor-specific cream, powder and floating debris.

prompt_instructions: Generate one flavor panel or the full 2 by 2 grid as requested.
Keep white background and high-key macro look consistent.
Attach product reference; do not substitute different chips or cream colors.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: { project_configuration: macro_still_image; global settings: aspect ratio 9:16, chaos weight 15, high-key clean-white backdrop, cinematic bloom, ethereal atmosphere; Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.2, shallow bokeh, focus on snack and cream interaction. Scene item 001: herb-seasoned crisp golden chips suspended mid-air with glossy thick-white Mediterranean herb cream frozen splash arc, liquid droplets, oregano flakes, thyme flakes and hyper-detailed crumbs; text HERB CRUNCH in bold extruded creamy-white 3D lettering with soft green edge glow, secondary text herb burst • ultra crisp • chef inspired. Item 002: suspended banana chips with soft creamy thick-white vanilla cream frozen burst, soft arc droplets, fine sugar dust and detailed banana crumbs; text BANANA BLISS in rounded pastel-yellow 3D bubble text, secondary text sweet crunch • real banana • smooth finish. Item 003: suspended lavender-tinted taro chips with glossy viscous pastel-purple taro cream frozen eruption, droplets, sugar dust and soft taro crumbs; text TARO POP in clean geometric pastel-purple 3D text with soft neon rim light, secondary text earthy sweet • creamy texture • premium bite. Item 004: suspended textured cheese crackers with thick pale-yellow cheese dip frozen splash, static droplets, cheddar powder and cracker crumbs; text CHEESE HIT with rich dip • bold bite • crunch impact. All typography floats in space and harmonizes with the splash composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong snack flavor, flat cream, muddy white background, unreadable 3D text, generic crumbs, low resolution, watermark
